Trait.name: Hard Worker
Trait.description: Drives themselves through long shifts and takes pride in a finished job.

Trait.name: Night Owl
Trait.description: Comes alive after dark and drags through the morning.

Trait.name: Gourmand
Trait.description: Lives for a good meal and suffers on plain rations.

Trait.name: Ascetic
Trait.description: Needs little comfort and thinks less of those who demand it.

Trait.name: Volatile
Trait.description: Feelings swing hard and fast in both directions.
